title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, land development (Melbourne)
content_text: Careers page: 'We're always keen to hear from talented people... Graduate and experienced civil engineers... Draftspersons'. 'We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au. We review every application.' Civil engineering: designing major estates and critical infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads.
apply_instructions: Email an introduction with CV to info@bpd.com.au (careers page)
